full_name: Tanya M. Smith | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Tanya M. Smith explores the evolution and development of human dentition. Teeth preserve remarkably faithful records, for millions of years, of daily growth and infant diet and also stress experienced during birth. Smith is an associate professor in the Department of Human Evolutionary Biology at Harvard University.
